- **Status:** Ready
- **Shape:** Story

- **Milestone:** Purpose: verifiability, preserved intent and reviewability

- **Story:** As Dana, I want to declare a unit as avow to "validate task title {title: Text}" in a .avowry file, so that the language and its files read as a promise the code makes.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given a declaration avow, then at most one filler from the fixed set to, that, it, then the quoted template, in an .avowry file, When it is built, Then it declares the unit exactly as the phrase keyword did, the filler is never part of the name (avow to "to do list" is named to do list), a second filler or an unknown word before the quote is an error that names the allowed set and shows the canonical form avow to, and the old phrase keyword and the .phrase extension are no longer accepted (the existing diagnostics; no compatibility, D127)
  2. Given every source and document in the repository (the demo, the fixture corpus, the inline sources in tests, orders and its file name, GRAMMAR.md and CHEATSHEET.md with avow to, the filler list and examples, the lexer and adapter keyword lists, the bench tooling and the scripts), When the card is merged, Then all are changed in this one mechanical commit (git mv for the files), the orders and document hashes are re-recorded, the one hash-binding test of the Usable v1 evidence is marked pending with its reason until card 162 reruns the LLM check, and nothing else is removed
  3. Given fixtures for each filler, the missing filler and the error cases, When the gate runs, Then all pass and each new test fails when its behaviour is removed (shown by a mutation); the generated C# differs only where the source text is embedded (hash recorded)
